scope: 35 unchanged committed source-sampler cases plus 18 fresh NoCurve event-boundary cases. Synthetic Model ObjectStroke setters/getters -> Drawing-selected GLV1 -> native RTV1 AddPoint and complete post-return vectors. No SDK deserialization, GLV2, texture binding, GPU draw, or paint output.

encoding.source_point_and_pressure_words: 8-digit hexadecimal uint32 word; interpret as IEEE-754 f32 bits
encoding.native_xyz_words: 8-digit hexadecimal uint32 word; native vector bytes decoded little-endian into f32 words
encoding.size_word: 8-digit hexadecimal uint32 word; decoded from source getter byte encoding

provenance.capture_source: The original 35 cases are copied byte-for-byte from the hash-pinned committed fixture after its own --check-fixture performs a fresh native replay. Each additional case runs an asserted in-memory adaptation of the hash-pinned MagicPen saved-caller wrapper. Wrapper SHA-256 uses a stable <FIXTURE_OUTPUT> placeholder. Every additional case records all source getter arrays, native metadata, per-RedrawPen invocation ranges, NoCurve line/end callback entry/return ranges, AddPoint args, and full post-return vector bytes.
